description: This file is a shell script containing a set of tests for Git reference transaction hooks. It defines various test cases to verify the behavior of hooks related to reference updates in a Git repository, including success, failure, state observations, and interleaving multiple hooks.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Checks if a pattern exists in input.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for prerequisites in the testing environment.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of a test script.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Simulates or invokes a hook for testing purposes.
